alerts.message: Creatinine last recorded 478 days ago for a patient on TDF. Consider ordering repeat renal function monitoring.

alerts.title: Creatinine not monitored for over 15 months
alerts.message: Patient on TDF-containing regimen has no creatinine result for 478 days. TDF is associated with nephrotoxicity, and renal function monitoring is essential for patients on this drug. The only available creatinine (88 umol/L) is from 2024-10-01, well outside any reasonable monitoring interval. The clinician's plan does not include renal function testing.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and urinalysis to assess renal function given TDF use. Establish regular renal monitoring schedule per guideline recommendations.

alerts.title: Viral load 40 copies/mL — confirm suppression status
alerts.message: Latest viral load is 40 copies/mL (2025-10-01), which is below the 50 copies/mL threshold for suppression. Guidelines state VL < 50 copies/mL on DTG-based ART should continue regimen. If VL < 50 for > 1 year with reliable adherence, monitoring can reduce to 12 monthly. This patient's VL should be repeated per the 6-monthly schedule unless suppression > 1 year is documented.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue current regimen. Confirm duration of viral suppression to determine if VL monitoring can be reduced to 12-monthly per guideline flowchart.
